name: Hatoba Sakura
source:
The older of the two Hatoba twins. Sakura is physically frail and spent years in the hospital when she was younger, which is why she’s a year below her sister as a freshman.

Nonetheless, she is unfailingly polite and treats everyone to her gentle smiles—so she’s quickly building a fanbase among the student body.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2680250/Holy_Maid_Academy/]Steam[/url]]
